questions.prompt: GTA 6 is out in the world now, and everyone's learning the same trick: how to flip your car in Vice City. Tonight, which scene sounds most like yours?

options.text: Flipping it on purpose — the chaos is the whole point tonight.
Showing the crew — look what I just pulled off in Vice City.
Driving it careful — my ride stays shiny, flips are for other people.
Already upside down — too much city, too fast, send help.

questions.prompt: The Avengers: Doomsday lineup is out — every team, all in one place, and the big night is starting to feel real. Tonight, how are you meeting a team-up this big?

options.text: Already buzzing — every team in one movie, I'm counting the days.
Picking my team — arguing with the group chat about who's carrying it.
So many teams, so many threads — my head's spinning trying to keep up.
Waiting for the trailer — the list is nice, but I want to see it move.

questions.prompt: The writer of the canceled Mass Effect revealed what would have happened to your squad — the ending you never got to play is finally out there. Tonight, what do you do with a goodbye you never got?

options.text: Reading it tonight — I need to know how their story ends.
Saving it for a quiet night — that goodbye deserves a slow read.
Leaving it alone — my version of their ending stands.
Torn — half of me wants to know, half of me wants to keep wondering.

questions.prompt: Thanksgiving lands Thursday — and Ford Field just showed off what it's serving fans on the day. If someone handled the table tonight, what would you want on it?

options.text: The full spread — turkey, sides, all of it, the table groaning.
Something to toast with — sparkling cider or champagne, virgin or hard, the table deserves it.
A warm mug of cocoa or cider — slow sips while the kitchen does its thing.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Rings of Power is coming back — Season 4 just got the green light, and Middle-earth is calling again. Tonight, which sound of that world is your vibe?

options.text: The full sweeping score — strings swelling, the journey pulling me in.
The Shire's gentle strings — soft, warm, and in no hurry.
The deep forest quiet — leaves, wind, and nothing else.
None of it tonight — my own quiet, Middle-earth can wait.

questions.prompt: The Black Friday hunt is on — the deals are live, the clock's ticking, and the wishlist is staring back at you. In the hour ahead, what does your hunt feel like?

options.text: Refreshing with a plan — the deal's in the cart before the hour's out.
Buzzing for the win — a steal this good deserves a little victory lap.
Still scrolling — too many deals, too many tabs, can't pick one.
Stepping away — the hunt can wait, I'm putting the phone down.
